text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Hm... This method would certainly allow
them to
train more efficiently without
adding physical
strain.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Going back to my earlier proposal, is
there
anything you'd like to—

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Apologies, I was just thinking about how
our
relationship has changed since we
first met.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I never would've imagined we'd reach a
point
where we could exchange opinions
like this...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: I suppose a lot has happened since then.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
The approach you take with your racer
has
reminded me of something
important.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I know you're not perfect, and there's
plenty I
would contend with you...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
But what I'm about to say is genuinely
how I feel,
Trainer
<username>.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I'm grateful to you. And I mean that from
the
bottom of my heart.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Then I suppose we feel the same way
about each
other.
choice_data_list: それはこちらのセリフです

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
We still have a long way to go before we
can
relax, but for now, why don't we call
it a day?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
We can invite <chrname>,
Little
Cocon, and Bitter Glasse out for
dinner after this.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
They're not the most social butterflies
out there,
but I'm sure they'd be excited
for a buffet.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Of course, there's no need to force
them. If they
decline, well...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
It would still be nice for us adults to
enjoy a
relaxed meal together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Everyone quickly agrees to come, and
we spend a
fun-filled night together.
